decisions.reason: As a standard handle family in the core architectural range, it remains inexpensive to carry and another year on the market without a negative signal increases the case for keeping the option open.

The multifunctional handle is still the most specialized offer among these products, but it supports the firm's barrier-free and system-solution strategy, so it should be retained while demand continues to clarify.
This handle line sits very close to established design, production and certification capabilities, so the cost of continuation is low and there is little reason to abandon it now.
The award-winning collection has strong signaling value for architects and specifiers and therefore has very high option value with a very low likelihood of withdrawal.
A finish variant is cheap to maintain in the catalog and complements the firm's architecture-led specification business, so it is more sensible to keep it unless demand turns clearly weak.
